steps.title: Welcome to Chipprs
body: This quick tutorial will show you everything you need to start playing.
Follow the instructions on this screen and try each action yourself.
You can use Back, Skip Step or End Tutorial at any time.

steps.title: Open the Practice Range

media.alt: Tapping Practice, then Practice Range in GSPro

body: On the bottom screen, tap Practice, then tap Practice Range.
The animation shows you exactly where to press.
Once you have done that, press Next.

steps.title: Wait for the Practice Range

media.alt: The Practice Range fully loaded in GSPro

body: Wait for the Practice Range to load on the bottom screen.
Once you see the screen shown in the demonstration, press Next.

steps.title: Position the Ball

media.alt: The ball registering in the hitting zone and the Uneekor light turning green

body: Place the ball inside the square in front of the simulator and wait for it to register.
When it is correctly positioned, the Uneekor light will change from pink to green.
You will also hear a beep, and the markers around the ball on screen will turn green.
Move the ball out of the hitting zone and back in again so you can see the ball unregister and re-register.
Once you are comfortable with it, press Next.

steps.title: Hit Your First Shot

media.alt: A shot being hit on the Practice Range with the ball trace shown

body: When the ball is registered, you are ready to hit.
There is no time limit, so feel free to take practice swings.
When you are ready, hit the ball at the screen.
If successful, you will see the ball trace through the air.
You can also see the statistics from the swing you just took.

steps.title: Leave the Practice Range

media.alt: Tapping the four dots and selecting End Round in GSPro

body: When you are finished on the Practice Range, tap the four dots in the corner and select End Round.
Once you are back at the main screen, press Next.

steps.title: Start a Round on a Golf Course
body: Now let's show you how to start a round on a golf course.
On the bottom screen, tap Local Match.
Once you have done that, press Next.

steps.title: Choose a Course

media.alt: Choosing a course and tapping Play in GSPro

body: Choose a course from the list.
If the course is already installed, select it and tap Play.
If you want to find another course, open All Courses and search through the available courses.
If a course is not installed already, tap Download and wait for the course to download.
For now, choose a course that is already downloaded and tap Play.

steps.title: Set Up Your Round

media.alt: Choosing round settings and players in GSPro

body: Choose the parameters for your game, add any extra players, and choose which holes you want to play.
When you are happy with your choices, tap Play in the bottom-right corner.
Then press Next on this screen.

steps.title: Play the Course

media.alt: Hitting the first shot on a golf course

body: When the course has loaded, once again place the ball in the hitting zone.
Wait for the ball to register and look for the green light.
Then swing away.

steps.title: End a Round

media.alt: Tapping the four dots and selecting End Round in GSPro

body: You can end your round at any time.
Tap the four dots in the corner and select End Round.

steps.title: Session Time and Extend Session

media.alt: Tapping Extend Session and entering a booking code

body: The time remaining in your session is shown in the bottom-right corner throughout your session.
When your time runs out, the system will automatically end the session and reset the simulator.
If you want to continue playing without losing your progress, book the following session in the same bay at Chipprs.golf.
Tap Extend Session and enter the 6-digit booking code for the following session.
The additional time will then be added to your current session.

steps.title: Help

media.alt: Opening Help from the corner of the screen

body: If you are ever unsure what to do, open Help from the corner of the screen.
You can also reopen this Quick Start Tutorial from the Help menu at any time.

steps.title: Incidents

media.alt: Opening Help, selecting Incident Report and scanning the QR code

body: If you have any issues during your session, or need to report a problem to us, open the Help menu and select Incident Report.
Scan the QR code with your phone and send us a message explaining what happened.

steps.title: Bay Lights

media.alt: Tapping the Light button to toggle the bay light

body: Tap the Light button in the corner to turn the bay light on or off.
If the light fails to turn on or off, tap the button again.

steps.title: You’re ready to play!
body: You now know how to use the Practice Range, position and register the ball, start a golf course, set up a round, end a round, extend your session, get help, report an incident and control the bay light.
You can reopen this tutorial from Help at any time.
